Indie Games That Inspired Us

2017

Hollow Knight

Team Cherry

A hand-drawn metroidvania built in Unity by a tiny Australian team. Became the gold standard for indie polish.

Unitymetroidvania

2018

Celeste

Matt Makes Games

A precision platformer about climbing a mountain — and mental health. Built in a custom engine (XNA/MonoGame).

MonoGameplatformer

2020

Hades

Supergiant Games

A rogue-lite dungeon crawler with deep narrative. Proved that early access + community feedback is a winning formula.

Customroguelite

2016

Stardew Valley

ConcernedApe

Solo-developed farming RPG built in C# over 4 years. A testament to what one dedicated developer can achieve.

C#simulation

2015

Undertale

Toby Fox

Subversive RPG made mostly in GameMaker Studio 2. Its meta-narrative and soundtrack redefined indie storytelling.

GameMakerRPG

2018

Dead Cells

Motion Twin

Roguevania action-platformer that nailed the feel of combat. Built by a small French co-op using Heaps.io.

Heapsaction

2019

Disco Elysium

ZA/UM

Revolutionary dialogue-driven RPG with no combat. Built in Unity by a collective of artists and writers.

Unitynarrative

2018

Into the Breach

Subset Games

Turn-based tactics with a focus on player agency and minimal RNG. Built in a custom engine.

Customtactics
